nodes.label: PTY Smoke Test Harness (S-95)
nodes.rationale: Forks skills-ui inside a real PTY driven by pyte (runner.py, smoke.py, skills-smoke-bin.ts) over a 120-skill fixture corpus because the in-memory bun test renderer is not faithful to real terminal rendering.

nodes.label: PTY Harness Gotchas & Contracts
nodes.rationale: Documents critical PTY invariants: use os.execvpe (not os.execv which drops env), pace keys with settle, set TIOCSWINSZ immediately after pty.fork, pin child cwd, and respect ESC keeping filter text by contract.
